# Goal
Kama-shokunin round 20 attempt 1, FALSIFY wave. L1 is the sole integration writer; wave members are advisory only. The committed build wave spawned 72 seats, 70 completed and CellDesign/SrcGateStandard died; none was replaced. This falsify wave has 86 distinct attack items; total spawned seats will be 72+86=158, under the 200-seat round cap.

# Claims and frozen evidence
C1 calibration 7 to 7: finite named error-versus-verdict regression set, 15 pinned cells, frozen/current evidence at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-20/runs/0957ce61/error-pair.stdout, measured tree 0957ce619789d13bb5779606078fa1498114d2c7. This is not an exhaustive error census.
C2 operability capability acquisition 8 to 8: offline GGUF declared metadata reader and comparison with an existing captured receipt; no serving, loaded-weight authentication or model-quality claim.
Routed R19 issues include crash-as-rejection, citation observed-digest selftest, 13 R18 citation instances, the R18 survivor-output scope, and S051's shifted anchor. Attack the fixes and limitations; do not equate summaries with full-document equality.

# Boundaries
Every input/output path is absolute under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin, except the validator-required relative reportDir. Tools start at fleet root. All seats are leaves; no subagent dispatch, model parameter, routing/config change, lane source edit, Git/JJ operation, fleet/sibling write, host/package/service/compositor/boot mutation, secret/private-config/vault access, persistent server, model load or large download. Read-only source inspection, public source reopening, and scratch testing are allowed. Scratch only under /tmp/kama-r20-<seat>, removed before return. Each seat may write only its own report under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-20/falsify/advice/.
Tooling directive: read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md before any installation; pacman transactions are paused, and any approved tool install would need official channel/version/reason recorded. No install is expected.
All Report trailer paths are relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin; write each report at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that-path>. L1 holds the frozen planner seat; connector is a read-only overlap check.
